All tests pass. Let me update HANDOFF.md to record the milestone 3 work.

{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && cat > HANDOFF.md <<'EOF'
# cachetools.tagged handoff

Implemented src/cachetools/tagged.py (TaggedCache) covering R01-R08.

- R01: put/get with deep copies, tag validation (finite iterable of strings,
  dedup, bare string/nonstring rejected before mutation).
- R02: invalidate(tag), replacement drops old tags, eviction prunes tags,
  get refreshes recency, put refreshes recency (Claim-A).
- R03: maxsize positive int excluding bool; invalid replacement leaves state;
  one slot per value.
- R04: invalidate_many(tags, mode='any'|'all'); empty tags -> 0; invalid
  mode/tags rejected before mutation; distinct removed keys returned.
- R05: resize(maxsize) validates first, preserves survivors + LRU order +
  absolute expiry (Claim-A round 2), shrink evicts LRU, grow no evict.
- R06: generator tags consumed once; detached nested values across gets/puts.
- R07: constructor timer=None (default time.monotonic); put ttl=None or
  finite nonnegative int/float (bool excluded); invalid ttl raises ValueError
  before mutation; ttl=0 immediately expired; exact boundary expired (now>=exp).
- R08: expired entries purged before get/put/len/resize/invalidate without
  touching survivor recency; overwrite replaces expiry; invalidation counts
  live only; missing/expired get raises KeyError; no-timer/ttl callers unchanged.

Tests: tests/test_tagged.py (own), acceptance_public.py, upstream tests/.
Run: PYTHONPATH=src:. python -m pytest tests/ acceptance_public.py -q
EOF
echo done"}
